rocBLAS F16 GEMMs for bounded Q4/Q6

comparison_to_pre_dual_profile.interpretation: The retained operation-complete owner removes the prior 128 FFN Q4 projection launches and all 64 standalone SiLU launches, replacing them with 64 dual launches. It materially reduces both kernel and host/submission work.

target_selection.selected_family: dual Q4T16 FFN gate/up plus SiLU
target_selection.reason: It is the only single family with enough isolated ceiling to close the remaining raw-parity gap. Its VGPR256/32-KiB geometry also exposes a concrete occupancy/dataflow hypothesis. Q5, GDN, attention, and residual families do not individually have enough ceiling.
target_selection.followup_outcome: All mechanism-driven exact follow-ups were rejected or noise. The retained zero-spill 32-column x 256-row kernel remains the local optimum; a future retry requires a fundamentally different dataflow or compiler schedule.

followup_geometry_screen.protocol: Actual immutable blk.0 FFN gate/up weights, at least three warmups, 9-31 alternating event samples per shape, and BF16-bit comparison to the unfused chain or retained library as applicable.

eight_wave_32_columns_512_rows.decision: rejected; halved weight reread cannot offset local256 scheduling/occupancy loss

48_columns_128_rows.decision: rejected; lower activation replay cannot offset 48-KiB LDS and cooperative-decode cost

serialized_gate_up_b_fragments.decision: rejected cross-board; tiny XTX gain regresses W7900 at production chunk sizes

quad_broadcast_q4_metadata.decision: rejected; coalesced metadata loads are cheaper than 36 owner-masked DPP quad broadcasts

k128_32_columns_128_rows_forced_two_bloc.resources: VGPR256, 678 VGPR spills, 2300 bytes/thread private segment
k128_32_columns_128_rows_forced_two_bloc.decision: rejected; forced occupancy contract spills catastrophically

k128_32_columns_128_rows_natural_one_blo.resources: VGPR256, 200 VGPR spills, 804 bytes/thread private segment
k128_32_columns_128_rows_natural_one_blo.decision: rejected; natural launch bounds still spill and cannot expose the intended residency gain

followup_geometry_screen.interpretation: Larger row live ranges collapse compiler scheduling; smaller tiles lose weight/activation reuse; local256 loses despite halving weight rereads; and 48 columns loses despite lower activation replay. A two-block launch bound does not change resources and is noise, a direct-register exact epilogue is non-uniform, serial B loading regresses W7900, metadata broadcast serializes decode, and K128 staging spills even without a forced occupancy contract. Retain 32x256/lb1 and do not continue a blind tile, wave-count, launch-bound, epilogue, metadata-transport, or K-stage sweep.
